scope: Actual Next route handlers and isolated MySQL tables; no production data mutations, paid calls or browser interactions

results.name: Additive session migration preserves legacy personal login and is idempotent
Anonymous admin bootstrap exposes identity branding only and protected data returns 401
Cookie transport helper follows actual HTTPS and nginx proxy protocol without using APP_URL
Both login and logout handlers issue Secure cookies for HTTPS while preserving HTTP compatibility
Ordinary credentials cannot create an admin session or register via the admin endpoint
Administrator login creates a dedicated server-side admin scope and cookie
Same account personal login remains a separate personal session
Copying tokens between cookie names cannot cross either portal scope
Personal API refuses every administrative route even with valid admin sessions
Admin API refuses personal records, chat, order and media activity
Valid admin read/save uses admin cookie, masks secrets and preserves personal bootstrap
Admin logout revokes only the admin token and does not affect the personal session
Personal logout revokes only the personal token and does not affect admin login
Swapped-cookie logout cannot revoke a token belonging to the opposite scope
Disabled, demoted and expired admin sessions are rechecked on every request
Admin password update revokes both portal sessions and renews only admin scope
Admin mutating operations enforce origin checks before authentication or database writes
